app.title: Ultimate Linux Installer
app.subtitle: A calm, guided UEFI install for one or more distributions
network.title: Network
network.lead: An internet connection is required for downloads and installs.
network.hint: If the check fails, set up Ethernet or Wi‑Fi.
network.scan_empty: No Wi‑Fi networks found. Scan again or enter a hidden SSID.
network.scan_prompt: Start a scan to show available Wi‑Fi networks.
network.wifi_help: Choose a network or enter a hidden SSID.
network.need_ssid: Select a Wi‑Fi network or enter an SSID.
network.connect_fail: Wi‑Fi connection failed. Check the password and network.
network.need_online: Without internet the installer can’t download distributions. Plug in a network cable or connect to Wi‑Fi.
network.guide_lan: • Plug in Ethernet or enable Bridged/NAT in the VM — address via DHCP.
network.guide_lan_up: • Wired/bridged link detected — if still offline, request DHCP again.
network.guide_wifi: • Or choose a Wi‑Fi network below and enter its password.
network.guide_no_wifi: • No Wi‑Fi adapter found — please use Ethernet/bridged networking.
mode.title: Installation type
mode.lead: Choose how the system should be set up.
mode.simple.desc: One distribution on the entire disk
mode.multi.desc: Multiple distributions with a shared boot menu
mode.add.desc: Extend an existing setup with another distribution
mode.remove.desc: Remove an installed distribution and free space
manage.title: Manage distributions
manage.placeholder: Existing systems are detected and can be added or removed.
distros.title: Select distributions
distros.proxmox.only_simple: Proxmox is only available for simple installation.
distros.empty: No distributions are currently available for this mode.
sources.title: Verify download sources
sources.lead: Before configuration, the installer resolves each selection's version, official source, and verification method.
sources.missing: No download source was returned for this selection.
sources.official_only: The installer only uses defined official project sources and verifies downloads before installation.
download.title: Downloads
settings.title: Settings
settings.lead: Configure accounts, SSH access, the boot menu, and storage allocation for unattended installation.
settings.ssh_help: Import public keys or paste one OpenSSH key per line. Only selected, valid keys will be installed.
settings.ssh_account_required: Enter a Launchpad or GitHub username first.
settings.disable_password_auth_desc: SSH only accepts the selected keys; local login remains available.
settings.equal_size_desc: Available space is allocated fairly and automatically.
settings.custom_size_desc: Set each distribution's root size yourself.
settings.data_desc: A separate area for files shared across distributions.
storage.title: Partition management
storage.lead: Choose the target disk and inspect the calculated GPT layout.
storage.warning: All data on the selected disk will be erased.
storage.usb_excluded: The installation medium is never offered as a target.
storage.empty: No partitions yet — select distributions first.
storage.too_small: Disk is smaller than the recommended minimum. Layout was adjusted — install may fail.
storage.disk_too_small: The disk is too small for this plan (needs about {required_gib} GiB, available {available_gib} GiB). Disable the data partition or reduce the swap/data size.
storage.equal_summary: Root partitions are distributed evenly; special partitions follow your settings.
storage.custom_summary: Root and special partitions follow your custom sizes.
storage.visual_label: Graphical representation of the partition plan
storage.warning_below_minimum: {distro} is below the recommended minimum of {gib} GiB.
storage.warning_swap_reduced: Swap was reduced so the plan fits the target disk.
storage.warning_swap_disabled: Swap was disabled so the plan fits the target disk.
review.title: Final review
review.lead: Check the target and plan. Only your explicit approval creates a short-lived confirmation token and starts installation.
review.erase_title: This disk will be completely erased
review.erase_body: The partition table, file systems, and all existing data on the device below will be irreversibly destroyed.
review.plan_fixed: Approval is bound to this exact plan and target disk.
review.no_fingerprint: The server did not return a valid plan fingerprint. Installation remains locked.
review.acknowledge: I checked the erase target and confirm the complete loss of data.
review.acknowledge_detail: My approval applies to “{model}” and exactly the plan shown above.
progress.title: Installation in progress
progress.lead: Verifying signed package sources, preparing the disk, and fully installing the selected systems.
progress.back_to_review: Return to review and approve again
progress.simulation_lead: The complete workflow is being tested without changing a real disk.
progress.simulation_notice: No real systems are installed and no data is erased.
progress.unverified_explanation: The backend reports that the job ended but does not confirm fully installed distributions. The UI therefore does not claim success.
done.title: Installation complete
done.body: All selected distributions and the central GRUB boot menu were fully installed. Remove the installation medium and reboot.
done.simulation_body: The installation workflow completed as a simulation. No distributions were installed and no disks were changed.
done.not_confirmed: The completion page stays locked until the backend confirms a real full installation or a dry run.
error.password_too_short: The password must be at least 8 characters long.
error.username_invalid: The username must start with a lowercase letter or underscore and may only contain lowercase letters, digits, hyphens, and underscores.
error.username_reserved: This username is reserved for a system account. Choose a different one.
error.hostname_invalid: Each hostname must be 1–63 characters and may only contain lowercase letters, digits, and internal hyphens.
error.hostname_duplicate: Each distribution needs a unique hostname.
error.ssh_invalid: At least one manually pasted SSH key is invalid.
error.ssh_key_required: When SSH password login is disabled, at least one valid SSH key must be selected.
error.sources_unavailable: Not every selected distribution has an available, verifiable download source.
error.destructive_unconfirmed: Destructive storage operation was not confirmed.
error.confirmation_missing: The server did not return a confirmation token.
error.view_title: This view could not be loaded
error.try_again: Go back and try again. This error did not approve any storage operation.
